title: Moon Rally
html:
Not to be confused with Moon Cup, which also uses a Power Moon as the emblem.

The Moon Rally is the third rally in Mario Kart World, represented by a Power Moon, mirroring the Star Cup. It begins in the far northwest of the map, at Bowser's Castle, before taking racers southeast gradually until they arrive at Faraway Oasis.

The Power Moon was previously used to represent the icon for the Moon Cup in Mario Kart 8 Deluxe.
